decisions.primary_representation: CO-PRIMARY (Holm-corrected over the 2): (a) global mean over all tokens, (b) union object-window mean (window = union over all variants of a world of the object's token path +2 tokens, so every variant shares one window)
decisions.precision: fp32 (bf16 rejected: 1.0-1.75% rel. error per block, see reports/gate0.md)
decisions.primary_layers: hierarchical taps blocks {5,11,17,23} after their own norms_block; all 24 raw block outputs exploratory
decisions.primary_hypothesis: H2 cross-context gravity alignment, compared against the tracked-trajectory baseline

delta_rule: delta_g=0.5 fixed in every scene; delta_e and delta_mu give the same peak trajectory displacement as delta_g inside the same scene (calibrated on 8 dedicated 'calib' seeds, NOT manifest worlds: bounce g(0.5) 0.222 m -> e 0.049; incline(v2) g(0.5) 0.040 m -> mu 0.0087; rounded to 0.05 / 0.009)

incline.design_v2: slope (38-42 deg, start 0.45-0.55 m up-slope) + flat run-out: slope accel g(sin a - mu cos a), flat decel mu*g => g and mu separable (v1 slope-only made them collinear, trajectory cos = -1.00)

split: per primary scenario 15 development + 15 held-out worlds by index parity (even index = dev) so every v1 dev world stays dev and no v1 held-out world was ever inspected; nuisance and composition split 5/5

gate1_v2.data: the 15 dev worlds per primary scene (held-out untouched), manifest settings (ss1, x1, delta as above), fp32, 64 frames
gate1_v2.criterion: for EACH of g@freefall, g@bounce, g@incline, e@bounce, mu@incline: split-half reliability of world-level derivatives >= 0.5 at >=2 of the 4 hierarchical post-norm taps, for at least one of the two poolings; AND hierarchical-tap consistency check passes. Reliability = mean cos between the mean derivative of two random halves of the 15 dev worlds (2000 random splits).

amendments.what: object-window pooling added as co-primary next to global mean
amendments.why: dev-world Gate 1b/1 preview: global-mean derivatives have split-half reliability 0.0-0.57 vs window 0.03-0.83
amendments.made_after_seeing: dev worlds only; held-out never touched

amendments.what: primary scenes grow from 10 to 30 worlds each (200 -> 460 clips); nuisance/composition unchanged
amendments.why: gravity derivative reliability only 0.3-0.6 with 5 dev worlds; more worlds is the direct fix

amendments.what: incline redesigned: slope + flat run-out; delta_e 0.04->0.05, delta_mu 0.02->0.009 recalibrated
amendments.why: v1 incline made g and mu collinear in trajectory space (cos -1.00, rank 1.01): not separable by construction

amendments.what: Gate 1 criterion replaced by gate1_v2 (split-half reliability across 15 dev worlds) declared before the new run; v1 Gate 1 and Gate 1b remain recorded FAIL
amendments.why: protocol compares world-averaged directions; per-world rule stricter than the analysis needs

amendments.what: validity threshold for 'intervention moves the object' changed from 0.05 m to 2 pixels of peak projected displacement between +/- variants (comparable across scenes); builder aborts after 400 rejections per family
amendments.why: the 0.05 m threshold was set for the v1 incline; the v2 incline g effect is ~0.04 m (~4 px) so it rejected 11/12 worlds and the builder looped. Scene-scale fix, made without looking at any held-out data.
amendments.approved_by_user: within approved amendment A3 (incline redesign); flagged to user

gate1c.purpose: does a larger gravity step make the g-derivative reliable? dev worlds only
gate1c.criterion: per m and case (g@freefall, g@bounce, g@incline): split-half reliability >=0.5 at >=2 of 4 hierarchical taps for at least one pooling; candidate = smallest m where all three pass
gate1c.status: done: candidate m=2 (delta_g=1.0); adoption pending user decision (amendment A6)
